nodes.description: Owner address stored by Ownable; gates onlyOwner protected functions.
Token balance mapping mutated in _tokenTransfer and burn.
ERC20 allowance mapping read/written in approve, transferFrom and _approve.
Fee exemption whitelist; written by addToWhitelist/removeFromWhitelist without access control.
Public blacklist mapping written by blockBots/unblockBot without ownership check.
Total token supply, used for maxTxAmount and renounce-less limit changes.
Current transfer tax rate; mutable by the unrestricted lowerTax function.
Recipient of collected ETH via transfer in sendETHToFee.
Max buy limit enforced in _transfer; reset by removeBuyLimit.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps, liquidity and pair creation.
Uniswap pair address set by createUniswapPair; treated as the buy side in _transfer.
Flag enabling contract-token auto swapping inside _transfer.
Reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, transfers and unguarded state changes.
Miner-influenced timestamp passed as swap and liquidity deadline.
Internal transfer routing that enforces limits, blacklist and triggers swaps before balance update.
Applies tax and updates balances; called after external swap interactions.
Approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH through the Uniswap router under lockTheSwap.
Forwards contract ETH balance to _taxWallet using transfer.
Public unrestricted entrypoint that swaps the full contract balance for ETH.
Public unrestricted entrypoint that drains ETH balance to the fee wallet.
Public function granting fee exemption to any address without ownership check.
Public function revoking fee exemption without ownership check.
Public function that lowers the transfer tax without ownership check.
Public function that raises _maxTxAmount to the full supply without ownership check.
Public function blacklisting arbitrary addresses without ownership check.
Public function removing an address from the blacklist without ownership check.
onlyOwner burn of a percentage of contract-held tokens.
onlyOwner pair creation and router approval for the whole supply.
onlyOwner liquidity addition that also enables swapping and trading.
ERC20 transferFrom delegating to _transfer then reducing allowance.
ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer with _msgSender as sender.
Ownership modifier comparing _owner with _msgSender.
onlyOwner ownership renouncement setting _owner to the zero address.
External Uniswap router swap call executed from _transfer path before balances are settled.
Native ETH transfer to _taxWallet forwarding gas and allowing receiver re-entry.
Write to _taxFee from a public function lacking any access control.
Write to the bots blacklist from public functions lacking access control.
Write to _isExcludedFromFee from public functions lacking access control.
Source address parameter of _transfer.
Destination address parameter of _transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer checked against _maxTxAmount.
Local holding balanceOf(address(this)) used to decide the swap size.
Amount of tokens passed to swapTokensForEth.
ETH amount forwarded by sendETHToFee.
Caller-supplied new tax rate in lowerTax.
Caller-supplied address added to or removed from the fee whitelist.
Caller-supplied array of addresses blacklisted by blockBots.
Computed burn quantity derived from contract balance and percentage.
Swap path array token to WETH used by swapTokensForEth.
Tax amount computed in _tokenTransfer.
Post-tax amount credited to recipient in _tokenTransfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into _owner during construction, making caller identity the ownership anchor.
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender, so caller identity drives every protected path.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the token sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance reduction.
Externally controlled addresses enter _transfer through transfer and transferFrom.
renounceOwnership can only execute when onlyOwner passes.
burn is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
createUniswapPair is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
addLiquidity is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer finalizes balances through _tokenTransfer after external interactions.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth and its external router call before balances are settled.
_transfer reads balanceOf(address(this)) from _balance to size the swap.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount buy limit.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether tax is applied inside _transfer.
The public bots blacklist gates who may pass through _transfer.
_tokenTransfer debits and credits entries of _balance.
_tokenTransfer applies the current _taxFee to compute the team cut.
tTeam is derived by multiplication and division of the transfer amount.
tTransferAmount is derived by subtraction from the transfer amount.
swapTokensForEth writes the router allowance into _allowances via _approve.
swapTokensForEth queries WETH() and calls the router stored in _uniswap.
swapTokensForEth performs the external fee-on-transfer swap call.
The lockTheSwap modifier toggles _inSwap around the swap execution.
The external router call can re-enter token transfer logic while contract balances are not yet updated.
swapForTax calls swapTokensForEth with the whole contract balance.
swapForTax reads the contract token balance from _balance.
collectTax forwards the contract ETH balance through sendETHToFee.
collectTax ultimately triggers the native ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
sendETHToFee executes _taxWallet.transfer(amount).
The native transfer forwards gas to the receiver, which can re-enter collectTax before completion.
addToWhitelist writes fee-exemption state from an unprivileged public entrypoint.
removeFromWhitelist writes fee-exemption state from an unprivileged public entrypoint.
blockBots writes the blacklist mapping with no ownership restriction.
unblockBot writes the blacklist mapping with no ownership restriction.
lowerTax mutates the tax rate from an unrestricted public function.
lowerTax lowers _taxFee directly, affecting every subsequent transfer.
removeBuyLimit sets _maxTxAmount with no authorization check.
removeBuyLimit reads _tTotal when resetting the maximum transaction amount.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline, making execution miner-influenced.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidity deadline.
createUniswapPair stores the newly created pair address in _pair.
createUniswapPair calls factory() on the router stored in _uniswap.
addLiquidity enables contract token swapping by setting _swapEnabled.
burn derives burnAmount from the contract entry of _balance using division and multiplication.
burn moves tokens through the internal _tokenTransfer routine.
addToWhitelist sets entries of _isExcludedFromFee to true.
transferFrom reduces _allowances using SafeMath subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is consumed only by _transfer for address validation and routing.
Parameter to is consumed only by _transfer for validation and recipient credit.
Parameter amount is the transfer quantity checked against _maxTxAmount inside _transfer.
Local contractTokenBalance is computed and used solely inside _transfer to size the swap.
Parameter tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
Parameter amount is the ETH quantity forwarded by sendETHToFee.
Parameter newTaxRate is assigned into _taxFee by lowerTax.
Parameter buyer is the address whitelisted by addToWhitelist.
Parameter bots_ is the array iterated and written into the bots mapping by blockBots.
Local burnAmount is computed and passed to _tokenTransfer inside burn.
Local path is the swap route array built inside swapTokensForEth.
Local tTeam is the tax computation local to _tokenTransfer.
Local tTransferAmount is the net credit local to _tokenTransfer.
